_comment: Per-platform profiles. Add a new platform (shutterstock, freepik, pond5, 123rf) by copying a block and adjusting its numbers. title_discouraged_words = words that should NOT appear in the title for that platform.

adobe_stock.label: Adobe Stock
adobe_stock.notes: Descriptive Title Case title, ideally 70-100 chars. The top 10 keywords carry the most weight.

vecteezy.label: Vecteezy
vecteezy.notes: Title 3-8 words, <70 chars, professional & free of subjective adjectives/resolution words. The first 5 keywords matter most. Recommended 20-30 keywords, one form per word (avoid plural+singular).
